name: JPCERT/CC
description: Japan's primary vulnerability coordination center managing the Japan Vulnerability Notes (JVN) database. Significant weight in the Asia-Pacific region.

peerReview.processDescription: Vulnerability report reception, Technical analysis by JPCERT/CC analysts, Vendor coordination for verification, JVN advisory publication with CVSS scores. Runs TSUBAME internet threat monitoring system.

attribution.attributionNotes: JVN IDs recognized in Japan and internationally. JPCERT/CC advisories carry significant weight in the Asia-Pacific region.

povsAlignment.description: Japan's vulnerability coordination center providing JVN advisories with international recognition.
